Use an automation that, on creation of each occurrence, auto-assigns, adds a bright label/priority, and moves the item into a dedicated “Weekly/Recurring” column so cards don’t silently end up elsewhere. For exceptions, always change “Only this occurrence” (or duplicate + archive the original) and leave a short comment tagging the teammate so there’s a clear audit trail. Keep a saved view or calendar sync showing the next 30–90 days and run a quick monthly audit/export to spot missed or mis‑placed occurrences. If you need to permanently change who or where the series lives, recreate the recurring series on the new board/user instead of repeatedly editing the original series.
